comment: Linking is exact inheritance rather than an offset: a linked phrase takes its group leader's value and its own trimmer is ignored entirely, so a stale trimmer position can never transpose a phrase. For the tempo output to set the tempo rather than nudge it, the Meter it feeds must have its own "BPM CV absolute" menu item turned on. A channel switched off in a phrase has its clock and bar outputs silenced rather than being muted downstream, and its reset output fires when it comes back.
